title: 地盤壓密灌漿~Compaction grouting
focus: 低流動性灌漿的擠密、孔壓與資產反應~Low-mobility grout displacement, pore pressure and asset response
summary: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。~Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement.

units.title: 不排水孔壓的機理與驗證~Undrained pore pressure mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 低流動性漿團擠壓飽和土時，短時間內若水無法排出，部分總應力增量會轉成超額孔壓而非立即增加土骨架強度。反應取決於飽和度及應力路徑，不能因為注入壓力高就斷言地盤已變密；持續孔壓還可能暫時降低鄰近穩定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。~Displacing saturated soil with low-mobility grout can convert much of a rapid total-stress increment into excess pore pressure rather than immediate skeleton strengthening. Response depends on saturation and stress path, so high injection pressure does not prove densification. Persistent pore pressure may temporarily reduce stability nearby. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以孔壓計與地表位移對照注入事件，檢查消散時間，並分辨管內壓力與土中孔壓。注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。~Compare piezometers and surface movement with injection events, assess dissipation time, and distinguish pipe pressure from soil pore pressure. Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone.
units.failure: 孔壓累積而未消散可能降低有效應力，使周邊地盤暫時軟化，補強過程反而造成位移。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。~Accumulated pore pressure reduces effective stress and can temporarily soften surrounding ground, causing movement during the improvement itself. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.
units.misconception: 注入壓力越高就表示土骨架已承受更多有效壓力。~Higher injection pressure always means greater effective stress in the soil skeleton.
units.practice: 注入與等待的判據應由孔壓及位移共同支持；地工設計者核定停留點，不以泵壓單獨判定。B係數式限於指定等向不排水路徑，真實漿團擴張具有剪應力變化；非等向情境需更完整的孔壓反應模型。~Use pore pressure and displacement together for injection and waiting criteria; the geotechnical designer approves hold points rather than relying on pump pressure alone. The B relation applies to the stated isotropic undrained path; actual bulb expansion changes shear stress and needs a fuller pore-pressure model for nonisotropic loading.

units.title: 孔隙比減少的機理與驗證~Void-ratio reduction mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 真正擠密需要土粒重新排列並減少土體孔隙，不能把漿液占據空洞直接當成原土密度提高。體積應變可由孔隙比變化估算，但前提是土粒體積不變且觀察的是同一土體；飽和細粒土還需要水能排出才能形成永久壓縮。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。~Densification requires grain rearrangement and reduced void space; grout occupying an empty cavity is not automatically denser native soil. Void-ratio change estimates volumetric strain if solid volume is fixed and the same soil mass is followed. Saturated fine soil also needs drainage for permanent compression to develop. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以處理前後密度與原位試驗比較，分層確認同一土體代表性，檢查材料移出或填入是否影響質量基準。成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。~Compare pre- and post-treatment density and in-situ tests by layer, checking representativeness and whether added or removed material changed the mass basis. Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators.
units.failure: 把空洞填充量當成土體壓縮量，會高估密實改善，處理後仍可能有鬆散土及差異沉陷。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。~Counting cavity fill as soil compression overstates densification and can leave loose ground and differential settlement after treatment. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.
units.misconception: 漿液填滿空隙與原土擠密是完全相同的改善機制。~Filling a cavity and densifying native soil are identical improvement mechanisms.
units.practice: 成效報告應分開填空、擠密與地層位移證據；地工設計者確認機制後才接受改善指標。孔隙比式沒有描述漿團形狀及影響範圍，亦不能把整個場址都視為同樣壓縮；需由空間取樣驗證分布。~Separate cavity-filling, densification and ground-displacement evidence in reports; the geotechnical designer confirms the mechanism before accepting improvement indicators. The void-ratio relation describes neither bulb shape nor influence extent and does not imply uniform site compression; spatial sampling must verify the distribution.

units.anchor: 漿泡等效半徑~Equivalent grout-bulb radius
units.title: 漿泡等效半徑的機理與驗證~Equivalent grout-bulb radius mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 低流動性漿材可形成團塊並向周圍擠壓，但實際形狀受土層、裂隙及應力控制，未必是球體。等效球半徑可把體積轉成直觀尺寸，僅供比較材料量與可能影響範圍；不能據此直接確定處理交疊或資產安全距離。等效半徑是體積換算，不是可測得的施工直徑或擠密半徑；流失、壓縮與裂隙注入都會改變實際幾何。~Low-mobility grout can form a mass that displaces its surroundings, but strata, fractures and stress control a shape that need not be spherical. Equivalent sphere radius converts volume into an intuitive size for comparison only; it cannot directly establish treatment overlap or safe separation from assets. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以試驗區揭露、原位反應及材料平衡核對形狀假設，檢查弱層是否造成扁平擴展或側向漏失。試驗方案需驗證地層控制的漿體分布；地工設計者確認有效影響範圍後才安排處理網格。~Check shape assumptions through trial-area exposure, in-situ response and material balance, examining weak-layer spreading or lateral loss. Trials must verify ground-controlled grout distribution; the geotechnical designer confirms effective influence before laying out the treatment grid.
units.failure: 沿裂隙形成細長漿脈時，球形假設會高估四周擠密範圍，並低估遠處資產受影響可能。等效半徑是體積換算，不是可測得的施工直徑或擠密半徑；流失、壓縮與裂隙注入都會改變實際幾何。~Elongated grout veins along fractures invalidate spherical influence, overstating nearby densification and understating possible effects on distant assets. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry.
units.misconception: 注入體積相同，就一定得到相同半徑的球形漿泡。~Equal injected volume always creates a spherical bulb of the same radius.
units.practice: 試驗方案需驗證地層控制的漿體分布；地工設計者確認有效影響範圍後才安排處理網格。等效半徑是體積換算，不是可測得的施工直徑或擠密半徑；流失、壓縮與裂隙注入都會改變實際幾何。~Trials must verify ground-controlled grout distribution; the geotechnical designer confirms effective influence before laying out the treatment grid. Equivalent radius is a volume conversion, not a demonstrated installation or densification radius; loss, compression and fracture entry change actual geometry.

units.title: 處理覆蓋比例的機理與驗證~Treatment coverage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 處理網格需涵蓋目標土層與資產下方，圓形影響區面積比可作初步幾何比較，卻不能證明各點都達到指定密度。相鄰孔交互擠壓及邊界效應會改變分布，未處理通道可能控制液化或沉陷表現，必須檢查連續弱區。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。~Treatment grids must cover the target strata and asset footprint. Circular influence-area ratio gives an initial geometric comparison but does not prove every point reaches target density. Interaction and edges alter distribution, while untreated corridors may govern liquefaction or settlement; continuous weak zones require explicit checks. This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設影響半徑r=0.5 m、正方形網格s=1.2 m，面積比a=πr²/s²=0.545。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For influence radius r=0.5 m and square spacing s=1.2 m, area ratio a=πr²/s²=0.545. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 在孔間及處理邊界配置原位試驗，將改善指標畫成平面及深度圖，檢查最低值連通性。驗收點應包含最不利孔間位置；地工設計者按功能需求核定覆蓋與補孔，不僅追求總孔數。~Test between holes and at treatment edges, mapping improvement in plan and depth and checking connectivity of the lowest-value zones. Acceptance includes adverse inter-hole locations; the geotechnical designer approves coverage and additional holes from performance needs rather than total count alone.
units.failure: 只在注入孔附近測試會高估覆蓋，孔間弱帶可能在後續載重或地震中仍產生集中變形。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。~Testing only near injection holes overstates coverage, leaving inter-hole weak corridors that deform under later loads or shaking. This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.
units.misconception: 面積比超過一半就表示整個場址都改善了一半。~An area ratio above one half proves the entire site is half improved.
units.practice: 驗收點應包含最不利孔間位置；地工設計者按功能需求核定覆蓋與補孔，不僅追求總孔數。這是幾何圓面積比，不是密實度、體積替代率或安全係數；影響半徑本身須由試驗建立且未必均勻。~Acceptance includes adverse inter-hole locations; the geotechnical designer approves coverage and additional holes from performance needs rather than total count alone. This is a geometric circular-area ratio, not density, replacement ratio or safety factor; the influence radius requires testing and may be nonuniform.

units.anchor: 孔壓消散時間~Pore-pressure dissipation time
units.title: 孔壓消散時間的機理與驗證~Pore-pressure dissipation time mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 分階段壓密灌漿需辨別材料反應與土體排水的時間，未消散孔壓會改變下一階段有效應力。壓密理論的時間因子可估指定排水長度的尺度，但真實三維排水及土層各向異性可能主導；排程不能只由設備可用時間決定。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。~Staged grouting must distinguish material response from drainage time because remaining pore pressure changes the next stage's effective stress. Consolidation time factors estimate a scale for a specified drainage path, but three-dimensional drainage and anisotropy may govern. Equipment availability alone therefore cannot set the waiting interval. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以孔壓計量測消散曲線，核對排水邊界及cv試驗應力範圍，檢查是否有未觀測的低滲透夾層。階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。~Measure dissipation with piezometers, verify drainage boundaries and the stress range of tested cv, and investigate unobserved low-permeability seams. Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change.
units.failure: 等待不足會使超額孔壓累積，注入後土體尚未增強就承受下一次擠壓，造成不利位移。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。~Insufficient waiting accumulates excess pressure and subjects ground to further displacement before strengthening, causing adverse movement. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.
units.misconception: 前一孔灌漿結束就代表附近土體已完成壓密。~Completion of one injection means surrounding soil has fully consolidated.
units.practice: 階段放行以核定孔壓及位移條件判定，地工設計者檢查排水假設後才調整等待安排。此一維式只是指定時間因子的尺度，Tv並非任意等同某百分比；需用相應理論關係解讀壓密度且不可直接當施工工期。~Release stages using approved pressure and movement conditions; the geotechnical designer reviews drainage assumptions before waiting intervals change. The one-dimensional expression gives a scale at a specified time factor; Tv is not itself a consolidation percentage and requires the matching theoretical relation rather than direct schedule use.

units.title: 地表隆起體積的機理與驗證~Surface-heave volume mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 擠密過程若土粒重排空間不足，注入可能轉成地表隆起或資產移動。以面積乘平均隆起可估觀測到的體積，但測區之外仍可能變形；把地表反應和注入量、孔壓一起比較，有助辨別壓縮、填空與抬升的比例。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。~When grain rearrangement has limited space, injection may become surface heave or asset movement. Area times mean heave estimates observed volume, but deformation can extend beyond the surveyed zone. Comparing this response with injected quantity and pore pressure helps separate compression, cavity filling and uplift contributions. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設觀測面積A=100 m²、平均隆起h=0.005 m，Vh=Ah=0.5 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For observed area A=100 m² and mean heave h=0.005 m, Vh=Ah=0.5 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用足夠密度的水準網積分位移，延伸到處理區外，並檢查是否有局部隆起被平均抹平。資產附近需依結構敏感度加密測點；地工與資產負責人共同核定隆起及差異變位停留點。~Integrate movement from a sufficiently dense levelling grid extending outside treatment, checking whether local heave is hidden by the mean. Increase measurement density near sensitive assets; geotechnical and asset leads jointly set hold points for heave and differential movement.
units.failure: 平均隆起低仍可能有局部尖峰，造成脆性管線或既有基礎接縫損傷，不能只看總體積。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。~Low mean heave can hide a local peak that damages brittle utilities or foundation joints; total volume alone is insufficient. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.
units.misconception: 地表平均只抬升幾毫米，就不可能有局部資產損害。~A few millimetres of mean surface heave cannot damage local assets.
units.practice: 資產附近需依結構敏感度加密測點；地工與資產負責人共同核定隆起及差異變位停留點。面積乘平均高程只描述測區表面變化，不等於全部漿液留存；應交代積分範圍、基準與測點密度。~Increase measurement density near sensitive assets; geotechnical and asset leads jointly set hold points for heave and differential movement. Area times mean elevation describes the surveyed surface only, not total retained grout; report integration extent, datum and sampling density.

units.anchor: 填空與擠密分辨~Void filling versus densification
units.title: 填空與擠密分辨的機理與驗證~Void filling versus densification mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 壓密灌漿遇到舊坑洞或鬆散填土時，漿液可能先填空，對周圍密度改善有限。材料平衡需區分已知空洞填充及真正擠移土體的部分，否則高注入量會被誤當高成效；不明耗量也是需要調查的地質訊號。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。~In old cavities or loose fill, grout may first fill empty space with little surrounding densification. Material balance should separate identified cavity fill from actual soil displacement, otherwise high consumption can be mistaken for high effectiveness. Unexplained consumption is also geological evidence requiring investigation. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設總注入V=3 m³，其中可證明填空Vvoid=2 m³，填空比例Vvoid/V=66.7%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For total injection V=3 m³ with verified cavity filling Vvoid=2 m³, the filling fraction is 66.7%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 以既有空洞調查、注入反應及後測密度交叉核對，追查高耗量卻低位移的區域。設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。~Cross-check cavity investigation, injection response and post-treatment density, investigating high-consumption zones with little measured movement. The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance.
units.failure: 高耗量若流入未調查空洞，可能無法改善目標土層，甚至轉移到鄰近設施造成堵塞。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。~High consumption into an uninvestigated cavity may leave the target stratum unimproved and migrate into neighbouring infrastructure. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.
units.misconception: 灌入量越大就能直接證明目標土體越密實。~Greater injected volume directly proves denser target soil.
units.practice: 設計者應核定不明耗量調查及停留點；填空成果和擠密成果在驗收中分開證明。比例只在空洞量可獨立證明時成立，剩餘三分之一也不能全部當作壓密；可能還有裂隙流失或地表隆起。~The designer approves investigation and hold points for unexplained consumption; cavity-filling and densification outcomes are demonstrated separately at acceptance. The fraction requires independently verified cavity volume; the remaining third is not necessarily all densification because fracture loss and surface heave may also occur.

units.title: 資產推力的機理與驗證~Asset reaction force mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 既有管線或基礎若限制地盤擠移，位移會轉成額外作用力，剛度越高不代表受影響越小。簡化彈簧模型能說明小位移對剛性資產的力需求，但接觸開閉、土體塑性與結構接頭會造成非線性，須以實際界面分析。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。~When an existing utility or foundation restrains displacement, movement becomes additional force; high stiffness does not mean low impact. A spring model illustrates force demand from small movement of a stiff asset, while opening contact, soil plasticity and joints introduce nonlinearity requiring actual interface analysis. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設資產等效剛度k=200 MN/m、強迫位移δ=0.002 m，F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For asset stiffness k=200 MN/m and imposed movement δ=0.002 m, F=kδ=0.4 MN=400 kN. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測資產位移與應變，核對支承邊界及接縫自由度，將地盤抬升轉換成相應結構需求。資產剛度與允許變形需由其結構負責人確認；灌漿設計者應依共同核定的界面模型訂控制目標。~Measure asset movement and strain, verify support boundaries and joint freedoms, and translate ground heave into corresponding structural demand. The asset structural lead confirms stiffness and permissible movement; the grouting designer uses the jointly approved interface model for control objectives.
units.failure: 忽略剛性資產約束可能低估內力，外觀位移很小仍可能有大反力或接頭損傷。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。~Ignoring stiff asset restraint understates forces; small visible movement can coexist with large reactions or connection damage. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement.
units.misconception: 資產很硬不容易移動，所以附近灌漿不會影響它。~A stiff asset barely moves, so nearby grouting cannot affect it.
units.practice: 資產剛度與允許變形需由其結構負責人確認；灌漿設計者應依共同核定的界面模型訂控制目標。彈簧常數屬特定方向與邊界，不是材料模數；兩毫米也不是通用允許變位，應與資產能力及不確定度比較。~The asset structural lead confirms stiffness and permissible movement; the grouting designer uses the jointly approved interface model for control objectives. The spring constant belongs to a direction and boundary condition rather than being a material modulus; two millimetres is not a universal permitted movement.

units.anchor: 原位阻力增益~In-situ resistance gain
units.title: 原位阻力增益的機理與驗證~In-situ resistance gain mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 處理前後錐尖阻力可比較地盤反應，但數值也受應力狀態、排水及測試位置影響。靠近硬漿團的高值不一定代表孔間原土同樣改善，應以統一程序和空間佈點評估；改善比更不能直接當抗液化安全係數。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。~Pre- and post-treatment cone resistance helps compare ground response but also depends on stress, drainage and test position. High resistance near hard grout does not prove equal improvement in native soil between bulbs. Use consistent procedures and spatial coverage, and do not interpret the gain ratio directly as liquefaction safety. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設相應地層qc由5 MPa增至8 MPa，相對增加(8−5)/5=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For comparable cone resistance increasing from qc=5 MPa to 8 MPa, relative gain (8−5)/5=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 對相同深度與地層作前後配對，記錄錐孔距灌漿孔位置，檢查孔壓及應力修正是否一致。驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。~Pair pre- and post-tests by depth and stratum, record distance from grout holes, and check consistent pore-pressure and stress corrections. Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain.
units.failure: 只選高阻力區會高估整體改善，未處理夾層仍可能控制沉陷或地震液化。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。~Selecting high-resistance areas overstates system improvement while untreated seams may still govern settlement or liquefaction. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.
units.misconception: 錐尖阻力增加六成，就代表所有承載與耐震能力增加六成。~A sixty-percent cone-resistance gain increases every bearing and seismic capacity by sixty percent.
units.practice: 驗收指標需對應設計功能與測試位置；地工設計者核定低值區處置，不以全場平均增益替代。百分比只比較兩個相應測值，未含統計分散與修正關係；要推估容量或液化阻抗，需另用經驗或力學模型。~Acceptance indicators match design function and test locations; the geotechnical designer determines low-zone treatment rather than substituting mean site-wide gain. The percentage compares two corresponding readings only, excluding scatter and correction relations; resistance or liquefaction assessment requires separate empirical or mechanical models.

units.title: 剩餘沉陷的機理與驗證~Residual settlement mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良完成後仍可能有未處理土層或低改善區，總沉陷需把各層剩餘壓縮加總。分層應變可提供清楚的量級，但時間效應與荷載擴散會改變分布；移交不能只附灌漿量，還要保存後測與尚未消散孔壓的證據。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。~Untreated layers or poorly improved zones can remain after completion, so total settlement includes residual compression of each layer. Layered strains give a transparent scale, but time effects and stress spread alter the distribution. Handover therefore needs post-tests and remaining pore-pressure evidence rather than injected volume alone. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設兩層H₁=5 m、ε₁=0.002；H₂=3 m、ε₂=0.01，s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For layers H₁=5 m, ε₁=0.002 and H₂=3 m, ε₂=0.01, s=ε₁H₁+ε₂H₂=0.04 m=40 mm. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 用分層沉陷及後測資料確認剩餘壓縮來源，對照未來荷載計畫，檢查地表變形是否符合各層加總。交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。~Use layered settlement and post-treatment data to identify residual compression, compare future loading, and check surface movement against the layer sum. Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements.
units.failure: 忽略未改良深層會讓完工表現短暫良好，後續荷載下仍出現持續沉陷及差異變形。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。~Ignoring deeper untreated ground can produce short-term apparent success followed by continued and differential settlement under later loads. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.
units.misconception: 表層原位試驗改善就代表所有深度的沉陷都已消除。~Improved near-surface tests prove settlement has been eliminated at all depths.
units.practice: 交接須列未處理層、剩餘沉陷及監測責任；地工設計者依資產需求確認驗收與長期追蹤。分層加總假設各層應變可代表其厚度，未含三維側移與結構互制；四十毫米是算例結果，不是允許沉陷。~Handover states untreated layers, residual settlement and monitoring responsibility; the geotechnical designer confirms acceptance and follow-up against asset requirements. Layer summation assumes representative strain through each thickness and excludes three-dimensional lateral movement and structural interaction; forty millimetres is a result, not an allowable settlement.

example: 原創教學例：假設飽和土受等向不排水總應力增量Δσ=100 kPa，Skempton係數B=0.9，超額孔壓Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa。只把總應力增量提高10%至110 kPa，B維持不變，Δu=99 kPa。這表示短時間內增加的荷載大部分由水壓反應承擔，不代表土骨架已永久增強。真實壓密灌漿並非等向試驗，還含剪應力、排水與漿泡形狀；應以孔壓消散及處理前後原位阻力共同確認改善，而非把高注入壓力當成密實度證據。~Original teaching example: assume saturated soil receives an isotropic undrained total-stress increment Δσ=100 kPa with Skempton coefficient B=0.9. Excess pressure is Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa. Increase only the stress increment by 10% to 110 kPa with B fixed and Δu becomes 99 kPa. Most of the short-term increment is therefore expressed in water pressure rather than demonstrated permanent skeleton strengthening. Actual compaction grouting is not an isotropic test and also involves shear, drainage and bulb geometry. Verify improvement using pressure dissipation and paired in-situ resistance tests rather than interpreting high injection pressure as density evidence.
history: 壓密灌漿主要藉低流動性漿團擠移周圍土體，適用性與排水、密實狀態及可容許位移密切相關。本課區分擠密、填空與劈裂，從孔壓、孔隙比、漿泡幾何及處理覆蓋出發，連結等待時間、地表隆起、資產推力與改善後的剩餘沉陷。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Compaction grouting displaces surrounding soil with low-mobility grout masses, with suitability governed by drainage, density and tolerable movement. The course distinguishes densification, void filling and fracture, connecting pore pressure, void ratio, bulb geometry and coverage to waiting time, heave, asset force and residual settlement. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：假設等向不排水增量Δσ=100 kPa、Skempton係數B=0.9，Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For an isotropic undrained increment Δσ=100 kPa and Skempton coefficient B=0.9, Δu=BΔσ=90 kPa
合成教學假設：假設e₀=0.8、e₁=0.7且固體體積不變，壓縮應變εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For e₀=0.8 and e₁=0.7 at constant solid volume, compressive strain εv=(e₀−e₁)/(1+e₀)=0.0556=5.56%
合成教學假設：假設漿體積V=0.5 m³且理想球形，r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For grout volume V=0.5 m³ in an ideal sphere, r=(3V/(4π))^(1/3)=0.492 m
合成教學假設：假設影響半徑r=0.5 m、正方形網格s=1.2 m，面積比a=πr²/s²=0.545~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For influence radius r=0.5 m and square spacing s=1.2 m, area ratio a=πr²/s²=0.545
合成教學假設：假設Tv=0.2、有效排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For Tv=0.2, effective drainage path Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s, t=Tv Hdr²/cv=8×10⁶ s=92.6 day
合成教學假設：假設觀測面積A=100 m²、平均隆起h=0.005 m，Vh=Ah=0.5 m³~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For observed area A=100 m² and mean heave h=0.005 m, Vh=Ah=0.5 m³
